fact: E-money institutions are legally required to run a 24/7 customer service handling complaints on loss, theft, fraud and unauthorised transactions, with oral complaints confirmed in writing within five working days, per 2424.mg.

Under article 101 of banking law 2020-011 the CSBF regulates and controls e-money institutions, ensures user protection and can sanction breaches up to withdrawal of licence; article 158 lets consumer associations go to court.
